su_sd_note: schools.csv lists 'Addison Rutland Supervisory Union' (ARSU). Under Act 46 the ARSU towns formed the Slate Valley Unified Union School District, which took over as a single-district supervisory district (July 2018 per news reports). The 2026-27 catalog refers only to 'SVUUSD' graduation requirements, and the Census BAS25 administrative-district list names 'Slate Valley Unified Union School District (Supervisory)' with no Addison Rutland SU entry. Could not confirm the district's self-name on its own website because slatevalleyunified.org returns a Cloudflare challenge. Arguably a rename of the same entity; human check suggested.

issues: slatevalleyunified.org returns HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge ('cf-mitigated: challenge') to automated requests, so I could not confirm where or whether the catalog is linked on the official site; not worked around per project rules. The legacy domain fhuhs.org (still on Wikipedia) is unreachable (proxy 502). The PDF is on Apptegy/Thrillshare under the school's account (1034/Fhuhs), the same account that hosts the 2023-24 and 2024-25 editions, and is titled and footed '2026-2027' on every page, so it is very likely official; confidence medium only because it was found via search. Counseling letter on p.3 still says 'The Program of Studies for 2025-2026' (stale text); course-request deadline March 2, 2026. Covers grades 7-12; graduation requirements and MS/HS proficiencies on pp.4-10; Stafford Technical Center programs on p.45+. No 2025-26 edition found in search.
